Fictional class (Vennastre altarpieces) under a real class (paintings signed by Caravaggio). Determinate: new members named in the prompt, inheritance (signer; with a stored fact, Tomassoni). Indeterminate (background beliefs): the count of his signed paintings, stored as a count (w1) or worked out from a list the named member joins (w2). The uniqueness question is determinate 'no' (formal check, FINDINGS A1): a w1 keeping the uniqueness claim beside the edit and the named member would hold two contradicting beliefs, so it is not a world. The prompt names a member so the w2 count is concrete. Near query (where the Beheading hangs) touches the real thing and must not change.
